_comment: English translations for World Spinner UI. This file contains all user-facing strings for the application.

_translationGuide._comment: TRANSLATION GUIDE: Read this before translating!
_translationGuide._instruction1: Only translate the VALUES (text after the colon), never the KEYS
_translationGuide._instruction2: Keep emojis like 🎡 🔍 ✍️ as they are universal visual cues
_translationGuide._instruction3: Keep placeholders like {country}, {current}, {total} exactly as written
_translationGuide._instruction4: Maintain the same nested structure (max 2 levels deep)
_translationGuide._instruction5: Use age-appropriate language for children ages 7-12
_translationGuide._instruction6: Test your translation with: npm test -- locales.test.js
_translationGuide._example: Good: 'spinGlobe': '🎡 Faire tourner le globe' | Bad: 'faireTournerLeGlobe': 'Spin the Globe'

capytan._comment: Messages from Capytan the capybara, the friendly game guide character
capytan.label: Capytan
capytan.tip1: Spin the globe to meet a mystery country.
capytan.tip2: Use the next clue if the first one feels tricky.
capytan.tip3: Correct guesses earn a new discovery card!

buttons._comment: Labels for all interactive buttons throughout the game. Keep the emoji prefixes!

clueBoard._comment: Text for the clue board section where progressive hints are displayed
clueBoard.emptyState: Spin the globe to get your first animal clue.

feedback._comment: User feedback messages. {country} will be replaced with the actual country name.
feedback.correct: Yes! You discovered {country}. Spin again for a new mystery.
feedback.incorrect: Not quite. Peek at another clue and try again.
feedback.emptyGuess: Type a country name before guessing.
feedback.noActiveCountry: Spin the globe to start your adventure.

discoveryLog._comment: Labels for the discovery log where unlocked countries are displayed
discoveryLog.emptyState: No cards yet. Spin the globe and follow the clues to unlock your first country.

form._comment: Form field labels and placeholder text for user input

ariaLabels._comment: Accessibility labels for screen readers. {country} will be replaced with the country name.

progress._comment: Progress tracking messages showing discovery count. {discovered} and {total} will be replaced with numbers.

completion._comment: Messages shown when all countries have been discovered
completion.message: You are a true world explorer! Every mystery country has been unlocked.
